# GulfCalc (gulfcalc.tech): LLM Knowledge & API Manifest
> An unmetered, client-side financial, tax, and labor law utility platform engineered for expatriates, corporate counsel, and HR leaders across the 6 Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states.

Website: https://gulfcalc.tech
Repository: https://github.com/Sheharyar-ans/gulfcalc
Jurisdictions Covered: United Arab Emirates (UAE), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), State of Kuwait, State of Qatar, Sultanate of Oman, Kingdom of Bahrain.
Architecture: Static HTML5 / Vanilla JavaScript / Pure Client-Side Computation (Zero PII leaves browser).

---

## 1. Statutory Calculators & Direct Routes

### Kuwait Indemnity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-indemnity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Kuwait Private Sector Labour Law No. 6 of 2010 (Articles 51, 53 & 55).
- Statutory Daily Wage Divisor: Mandatory 26 working days (Article 55: Daily Wage = Monthly Remuneration / 26).
- Accrual Scale: 15 working days per year for years 1-5; 30 working days per year for year 6 onwards.
- Maximum Statutory Cap: 1.5 years remuneration (18 months of monthly salary).
- Resignation Deductions (Article 53): 0% (<3 yrs); 50% (3-5 yrs); 66.67% (5-10 yrs); 100% (10+ yrs).

### Saudi End of Service Award (EOSA) Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-end-of-service-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Saudi Labour Law (Royal Decree No. M/51), Articles 84, 85, 86, 87.
- Wage Calculation Basis: Actual Wage (Basic Salary + Fixed Housing Allowance + Fixed Transport Allowance).
- Accrual Scale: 15 days (half month) per year for first 5 years; 30 days (full month) per year thereafter.
- Resignation Deductions (Article 85): 0% (<2 yrs); 33.33% (2-5 yrs); 66.67% (5-10 yrs); 100% (10+ yrs).
- Article 87 Exceptions: Full 100% award payable upon female resignation within 6 months of marriage or 3 months of childbirth, force majeure, or employer default under Article 81.

### UAE End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (Article 51).
- Wage Calculation Basis: Last drawn Monthly Basic Wage (excludes allowances).
- Accrual Scale: 21 calendar days per year for years 1-5; 30 calendar days per year for year 6 onwards.
- Maximum Statutory Cap: 2 years basic salary (24 months of basic wage).
- Harmonized Resignation: 100% identical entitlement for resignation and employer termination once 1 continuous year is completed.

### Qatar End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/qatar-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Qatar Labour Law No. 14 of 2004 (Article 54) & Ministry of Labour Guidelines.
- Wage Calculation Basis: Last drawn Monthly Basic Wage.
- Statutory Minimum Accrual: Minimum 21 calendar days (3 weeks) per completed year of service.
- Fractional Tenure: Exact pro-rata calculation for partial months and days.
- Resignation Treatment: Full entitlement payable upon completion of 1 year.

### Oman End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/oman-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Oman Labour Law under Royal Decree No. 53/2023 (Article 61).
- Statutory Accrual: Flat 30 days (1 full month basic wage) for every completed year of service starting from year one.
- Legacy Transition Engine: Accommodates repealed RD 35/2003 (15 days for first 3 years, 30 days thereafter) for pre-July 2023 tenures.

### Bahrain End of Service Indemnity (EOSI) & VAT Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/bahrain-eosi-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Bahrain Labour Law for Private Sector (Law No. 36 of 2012, Article 116).
- Statutory Accrual: 15 days wage per year for years 1-3; 30 days (one month) per year for year 4 onwards.
- SIO Expat Accruals: Aligned with 2024 Social Insurance Organisation deposit regulations (Decision No. 109/2023).
- VAT Module: 10% standard Bahrain VAT addition and extraction calculation engine.

### UAE Corporate Tax Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-corporate-tax-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses.
- Statutory Rates: 0% on net taxable profits up to AED 375,000; 9% on net taxable profits exceeding AED 375,000.
- Small Business Relief (SBR): Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023 relief election for resident taxable businesses with gross annual turnover <= AED 3,000,000.

### GCC Remittance True Cost Engine
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-remittance-fee-calculator.html
- Purpose: Unmasks hidden foreign exchange markups embedded by exchange houses and banks.
- Formula: True Drag = Upfront Flat Fee + (Send Amount * FX Markup Spread %).
- Corridors: Origin (AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD) to Destination (INR, PKR, PHP, BDT, EGP).

### Saudi GOSI & SANED Contribution Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-gosi-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Saudi Social Insurance Law (Royal Decree No. M/22) and SANED Unemployment Insurance (Royal Decree No. M/18).
- Citizen Contributions: 9.75% Annuity Branch + 0.75% SANED (Employee: 10.5%; Employer: 10.5% total 21.0%).
- Expatriate Non-Saudi Contributions: Flat 2.0% Occupational Hazards branch paid 100% by employer (0% deduction from expat salary).
- Statutory Ceiling: 45,000 SAR monthly contributory wage cap.

### GCC Inter-City Cost of Living & Expat Parity Comparator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-cost-of-living-comparator.html
- Purpose: Benchmarks purchasing power, compensation parity, rent, international schooling, and tax/VAT impacts across major GCC business hubs.
- Cities Covered: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah, Doha, Kuwait City, Muscat, Manama.
- Mechanics: Indexes baseline price baskets, weighted rent ratios, school fee differentials, and consumption tax friction to compute equivalent gross compensation requirements.

### Kuwait PIFSS Social Security & Expat Net Pay Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-pifss-net-salary-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Kuwait Social Security Law (Amiri Decree No. 61 of 1976) administered by PIFSS.
- Citizen Employee Deduction: 10.5% monthly basic salary (7.5% Basic System + 2.5% Supplementary System + 0.5% Unemployment).
- Expatriate Deduction: 0.0% (Expatriates are not covered by PIFSS; 100% of agreed contractual remuneration is received net).
- Statutory Ceiling: 3,000 KWD monthly maximum contributory wage for Kuwaiti nationals.

### UAE Investor Golden Visa Real Estate & Yield Calculator
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-golden-visa-property-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022 regarding Golden Visa Executive Regulations.
- Minimum Threshold: AED 2,000,000 property purchase value (single property or cumulative portfolio).
- Transactional Cost Engine: Computes mandatory 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) transfer fee, AED 4,200 trustee registration fees, and agency commissions.
- Financing & Equity: Evaluates 20% down payment mortgage rules, debt service coverage, and projected net rental yields after service charges.

## 2. Central Comparative Legal Directories

### GCC Labour Laws Comparative Directory
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/labour-laws/index.html
- Scope: Central comparative statutory analysis of employment legislation across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain.
- Features: Cross-border comparative matrices, statutory notice periods, minimum wage mandates, daily wage formulas, and direct calculation links.

### GCC Legal & Financial Intelligence Hub (Blog Directory)
- URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/index.html
- Scope: Searchable repository of 10 in-depth legal, tax, and employment intelligence articles.

## 3. High-Intent GCC Legal & Financial Research Articles

1. **UAE Gratuity Calculation Under Limited Contracts in 2026**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-gratuity-calculation-limited-contract-2026.html
   - Statute: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021
   - Topic: Elimination of contract type distinctions and historical resignation reduction penalties.

2. **Saudi Labour Law Articles 84 & 85: Resignation Rules & Actual Wage**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/saudi-labor-law-article-84-85-resignation-rules.html
   - Statute: Royal Decree No. M/51
   - Topic: MHRSD actual wage definition, 2-5 and 5-10 year deduction tiers, Article 87 statutory exemptions.

3. **Kuwait Labour Law Article 55: The 26 Working Days Rule**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/kuwait-labor-law-article-55-26-days-calculation.html
   - Statute: Kuwait Private Sector Labour Law No. 6 of 2010
   - Topic: Why the 30-day divisor violates Kuwait law, judicial enforcement by PAM, and mathematical proofs.

4. **Oman Labour Law Royal Decree 53/2023: The 30-Day Gratuity Standard**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/oman-new-labor-law-royal-decree-53-2023-gratuity.html
   - Statute: Royal Decree No. 53/2023
   - Topic: Abolition of the two-tiered scale and shift to flat 30 days per year from year one.

5. **UAE Corporate Tax: Small Business Relief (SBR) Compliance Guide**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-corporate-tax-small-business-relief-guide.html
   - Statute: Federal Decree-Law No. 47/2022 & Ministerial Decision No. 73/2023
   - Topic: AED 3,000,000 gross revenue threshold, qualifying person criteria, transfer pricing documentation rules.

6. **Qatar End of Service Benefits & Statutory Overtime Under Law No. 14/2004**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/qatar-end-of-service-benefits-overtime-wages.html
   - Statute: Qatar Law No. 14 of 2004
   - Topic: 21-day annual accrual, pro-rata service calculations, and 125%/150% overtime rate formulas.

7. **Bahrain SIO Expatriate End of Service Reform: Direct Deposit Framework**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/bahrain-sio-expat-end-of-service-reform.html
   - Statute: Law No. 36 of 2012 & Ministerial Decision No. 109 of 2023
   - Topic: Centralization of expatriate terminal indemnity deposits (4.2% and 8.4%) into the SIO fund.

8. **GCC VAT Reverse Charge Mechanism: Cross-Border SaaS & Services**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/gcc-vat-reverse-charge-mechanism-cross-border-services.html
   - Statute: UAE Decree-Law 8/2017 & Saudi Unified VAT Law
   - Topic: Accounting for foreign cloud hosting, SaaS, and consulting invoices under RCM self-assessment.

9. **Dubai Golden Visa 2026: Real Estate & Salary Thresholds Compared**
   - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/dubai-golden-visa-real-estate-salary-thresholds.html
   - Statute: Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022
   - Topic: Cost and legal comparison of AED 2,000,000 property investment vs AED 30,000 executive salary tracks.

10. **DEWS vs Traditional Gratuity: Mathematical Comparison for Expatriates**
    - URL: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/dews-vs-traditional-cash-gratuity-uae-workplace-savings.html
    - Statute: DIFC Employment Law No. 2/2019 & Cabinet Decision No. 96/2023
    - Topic: Monthly defined contribution workplace savings compounding vs traditional final salary cash lump sums.
